summary:
Historical since 2026-10-30: fdev is now a KVM VM (environment/fdev-kvm-vm) and the receiver runs inside it (environment/home-subsystems-migrated-into-fdev); in fdev `fsgg-store.lan` resolves to 127.0.0.1 and Home's 169.254.1.2:8447 is no longer an allowed destination.

Original lesson, still valid for any rootless Podman container with pasta networking on Home: pasta copies the host address (192.168.1.129) into the container, so connecting to it reaches the container's own namespace; reach the host through 169.254.1.2 (host.containers.internal) instead. The same effect applies to fdev's VMM container, which is why fdev's own host aliases use 169.254.1.2. Earlier details (per-process /etc/hosts override with unshare/setpriv, #4705; #4516 comments 6343424577 and 6343768096) are in the superseded version.
title: HISTORICAL (until 2026-10-30): fdev was a rootless Podman container with pasta; fsgg-store.lan looped back
